Few tips:
1) Answer confidently and when I mention it ,I really mean it , because the interviewer should not have a perception that you are getting nervous.
2) Also explain everything in depth considering the interviewer does not know anything and you have to explain him everything from the scratch.
3)Even if you do not know the answer of any question ,try responding it with the least information and knowledge that you have rather than directly saying NO
4) look straight into the eyes of the interviewer ie maintain proper eye contact while talking and explaining
5) A tip that make sure you speak the most of the time during interview,ie if it is of 30 minutes make sure you  speak for the 22-23 minutes and give less chance to the interviewer to speak, because if he speaks there are chances that he may ask something out of the blue ,so better guide and lead your own interview.
6) Ask for little permissions that sir shall I also cover this portion of the topic or question asked ,it basically shows little gestures of respect .
7) Last but not the least  believe in thy ,in yourself and the hardwork you did and hold your horses throughout the interview as because success is always the deadly combination of hardwork + luck.
